install_id.description: Random persistent identifier scoped to one HERMES_HOME.

dimensions.description: v3 rows carry call_role/error_class/outcome (and ttft_bucket from the decision-data build); rows counted by an older build carry only model/provider.
skill_name is a bundled/optional skill name or 'custom'; absent on rows counted before it existed.

vocabulary_identifier.description: Closed vocabulary owned by hermes_cli/observability/shared_metrics_contract.py (derived from in-repo registries); values outside it are never emitted.

dimensions.description: The five decision-data fields are absent on snapshots counted before they existed. The six version-lag/channel/hardware fields are absent on snapshots counted before they existed.
value is the summed token count for the day, not an event count.

catalog_identifier.description: A public name Nous publishes (slash-command registry, bundled/optional skills, optional-mcps/ and plugin-catalog/ entries, shipped locales), or the placeholder custom/plugin/skill/unknown/other.

dimensions.description: One per tool call a model emitted; issue=none when clean, so issue rates have a denominator.
A user friction action attributed to the model that produced the turn.
One per closed session: the fullest primary-model context it reached.
One per patch/write_file tool call; match_strategy is the fuzzy-match strategy that landed an applied patch (the loosest one for a multi-hunk V4A patch), none otherwise.

At most once per turn per (signal, detector): repeated_tool_call = a warning the call still ran with, loop_detected = the harness blocked or halted, iteration_cap = the turn spent its iteration budget.
One per failed tool call: what the model's next tool call did (the next call to the same tool, else its first call), or no_tool_call / gave_up when the turn ended without one.
One per foreground terminal command that reached an exit status; command_kind comes from a fixed table of first program words, never the command text.
One per primary model response; issue=none when the response is usable, so issue rates have a denominator.
